description: RC thermal model for hybrid supercapacitor (battery-type + EDLC electrode): temperature-dependent ESR and capacitance
source: Zhang & Zhao (2009) Chem. Soc. Rev.; Naoi et al. (2012) Energy Environ. Sci.; Berrueta et al. (2019) IEEE Trans. Ind. Electron.

cell.name: Hybrid Supercapacitor (lithium-ion capacitor or asymmetric pseudocapacitor)
cell.note: Battery-type anode (Li intercalation) + EDLC/pseudocapacitor cathode. Higher energy density than EDLC, higher power than battery.

capacitance_ref.note: Nominal capacitance at T_ref. Naoi et al. 2012: 2000-10000 F for LIC cells

esr_ref.note: Equivalent series resistance at T_ref. Low ESR of LIC vs. EDLC. Berrueta 2019

v_max.note: Upper voltage limit for LIC (limited by Li intercalation electrode)

leakage_resistance.note: Self-discharge leakage resistance. Lower than pure EDLC due to battery-type electrode.

E_a_esr.note: Activation energy for ESR Arrhenius. Hybrid SC has lower E_a than pure EDLC (~5-10 kJ/mol). Berrueta 2019

alpha_C.note: Capacitance temperature coefficient. Hybrid shows ~0.4%/K increase. Naoi et al. 2012

dC_dV.note: Voltage-dependent capacitance coefficient (linearized). Set to 0 for simplified model; use F1c for full nonlinear.
